name: Taipei 101
description: 101 Tower, also known as Taipei 101 Tower, is located in Xinyi District, Taipei City, Taiwan. Construction started in 1999 and was completed and opened on December 31, 2004. It was jointly funded by twelve banks and industries in Taiwan. The building is 508 meters high, with 101 floors above ground and 5 floors below. It held the record as the world's tallest building from December 31, 2004 to January 4, 2010. The building combines oriental classical culture and Taiwanese local characteristics. Its shape is like a strong bamboo, rising steadily and being flexible.
